The best,my dog is looking very beautiful 😍 …

Majestic Pooch is an excellent grooming service. Please don't be put off by the fact that this is a business run from a private residence. It is a professional service, offers clean premises and the staff are polite and courteous. Dogs have a large space to play and they have access to the garden, which I'm sure must be nice for them. I've had terrible experiences with larger and small grooming businesses that operate from business premises so I'm just pleased that I've found this place, at last. You won't be disappointed and Mohammad is fabulous!✨️
Great job again. Really care about the dogs
My boy always leaves looking fresh, highly recommend very professional.

Excellent grooming for my two dogs.  On their first visit they were  initially quite restless however they soon settled down. They actually enjoy their grooming sessions now.
Mohammed is very precise about what time i should pick them up and is always ready when i arrive.
Thank you Mohammed for your excellent service as always. The girls actually love their grooming sessions with you.
Absolute stars.  The time and patience they have is adorable and what a splendid job.  Thank you Mo.  See you in 6 weeks

Very positive first grooming experience for my 7 month old cavapoo Bailey.
Jess gave her a beautiful natural trim and It was honestly beyond my expectations.
She keep her lovely natural wavy hair and made her look even cuter! ( pics before and after).
Mohamed was so welcoming. Bailey felt at home right away and didn’t wanted to leave when I came to pick her up.
Looking forward to her next groom 🤩
